failures.rationale: Han used 65.5 mm, 230 g carom balls and a pocketless three-cushion table; absolute restitution values cannot directly validate Chinese-pool cushion parameters.
The paper prints Eq. (26) and a 0.6-0.95 measured range but no explicit velocity endpoints; 0.5-2.5 m/s is the preregistered evaluation domain, not a claimed apparatus sampling range.
